title: One Thing Today
style: warm upbeat pop, 108 BPM, encouraging bright energy, anti-scroll anthem, PLUGGED theme, deliberate learning, achievable daily goal, chantable hook, male vocal warm NZ/AU accent, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
Not asking for everything
Not asking for the year
Not asking for the perfect plan
Just asking — what's one thing here?
One word in Japanese
One breath before you eat
One move from Tai Chi
One day — compete

[CHORUS]
One thing today — just one
One thing today — begun
One thing today — that's enough
One thing today — not tough
One thing — PLUGGED — one thing
One thing today — begin

[VERSE 2]
The scroll gives you everything
Which means it gives you nothing
PLUGGED gives you one thing daily
That's the better something
Language, movement, breath, or code
One track — one lesson — one mode
One thing today — that's the load
One thing — carry it — hit the road

[OUTRO]
One thing. Today. That's enough.
